type: object of typeChange, branchChange, and delete policy overrides
default: absent; resolve each operation from scoped config, global default, then documented fallback
effect: supplies independent local policies for destructive type changes, branch changes, and deletion without changing mutation permission
precedence: each local operation overrides config.jsonformsExtended.confirmation.renderers[catalogId][operation], then config.jsonformsExtended.confirmation.default, then operation fallback; flat config.confirmation is ignored

default: complex for mixed type changes when no scoped or global policy applies
effect: controls whether changing or clearing a mixed type prompts over the discarded old value; the action still rechecks permissions and target identity
precedence: local typeChange, then catalog-scoped config, then global confirmation default, then complex fallback; malformed values are ignored

default: always when no scoped or global policy applies
effect: controls prompting for a oneOf branch switch or clear using only data that the switch discards, including choice-card branch selection
precedence: local branchChange, then oneOf catalog config, then global confirmation default, then always fallback; malformed values are ignored

default: complex when no scoped or global policy applies
effect: controls one confirmation over the values actually discarded by a permitted delete; acceptance rechecks ownership, permissions, bounds, and target identity
precedence: local delete, then semantic catalog config, then global confirmation default, then complex fallback; malformed values are ignored
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte/src/lib/{confirmation.ts,deletionConfirmation.svelte.ts,additionalItems.svelte.ts,compositeActions.svelte.ts} and family collection, tree, list, additional-property, and AG Grid renderers
